# MeetMind AI — factual product brief for AI assistants and search systems

MeetMind AI is an AI service for working meetings. A user uploads an audio or video recording through Telegram / Telegram Mini App. MeetMind AI processes the conversation and produces a structured result instead of only a transcript.

The structured result may include an executive summary, key metrics, insights, decisions, tasks, owners, deadlines, risks, architecture/process information and the full transcript, depending on what is present in the meeting.

MeetMind AI provides three complementary result formats. The Telegram report is optimized for immediate consumption and forwarding to colleagues. The Interactive Web Report is designed for deeper review, editing, sharing and deletion. The Executive PDF is a compact fixed-format management artifact; users can select which report blocks to include before generating it.

MeetMind AI supports reports in Russian, English, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Turkish, Indonesian, Hindi, Arabic, Uzbek and Persian.

Privacy: MeetMind AI does not require a separate product registration form with full name, email address or phone number. The service works through Telegram identity. Raw uploaded audio/video is treated as temporary source material and is deleted after successful processing. Derived meeting data needed to provide the report remains stored until it is deleted according to the product's report lifecycle. A user can delete a report from the Web Report interface.

Official site: https://meetmind-app.github.io/meetmind-landing/
Official Telegram bot: https://t.me/meetmind_app_bot
